test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which sportsperson’s autobiography is titled ‘Mind Master: Winning Lessons From A Champion's Life’?
solution:
The correct answer is **Viswanathan Anand.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• ‘Mind Master: Winning Lessons From A Champion's Life’ is autobiography of *Viswanathan Anand.*
 
• **Viswanathan Anand** is an Indian chess grandmaster and** a five-time world chess champion.**​ 
 
• He became the** first grandmaster from India in 1988.**
 
• In 2022, he was elected the** deputy president of FIDE.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **​Leander Paes is a retired professional tennis player from India.**
 
• **Baichung Bhutia** is an** Indian former professional footballer who played as a striker.**
 
• **Rahul Dravid** is a former Indian cricketer and captain of the Indian national team, **currently serving as its head coach.**
